## 🎓 Today's lesson

- **Sectoral Capital Rotation:** Sectoral capital rotation occurs when institutional investors move large amounts of money out of one asset class or industry into another based on changing economic conditions. For instance, when global investors grew concerned about high tech valuations and potential AI regulation in the US, they sold tech equities and redirected capital into emerging markets like India. This inflow drove domestic stock indexes higher even as global tech markets experienced sharp drops.
